questions.question: What are the immediate benefits of using the AWS Cloud? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Two immediate benefits are replacing capital expense with variable, pay-as-you-go expense (B) and increased agility — provisioning resources in minutes (D). The cloud reduces IT heavy lifting rather than increasing staff, and the customer (not AWS) is responsible for security IN the cloud.
